correctness.rationale: The Stirling transform is formally integral and finite modulo \(2^e\). Carmichael units and even-base powers prove periodicity beginning \(e\), while at \(n=e-1\) exact reduction to \(j\equiv2\pmod4\) yields \(2^{e-1}(g_2+g_3)\) with parity 1. An arbitrary earlier period contradicts the periodic tail gcd theorem. Exact formal coefficient and indicator certificates executed successfully. No finite experiment is used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determining the exact least preperiod across every power-of-two modulus is a complete and natural missing arithmetic invariant left open by the explicit though not necessarily sharp bound in Kallat. The uniform nonzero discrepancy at the boundary provides a structural lemma; the already established least-period results, including the modulus-16 example, are acknowledged rather than relabeled.
